item.title: My Skills
item.description:
A brief summary of my skills

As a software developer I posses strong technical skills and expert-level proficiency with a variety of subjects and technologies. These include:

  • Full-stack Software Development
  • Front-end Frameworks such as React and Angular
  • Backend Frameworks such as ASP.NET, Spring Boot, and Express
  • Databases, including Oracle, MySQL, and PostgreSQL
  • Multiple different programming languages including Java, C#, C++, and Python
  • Software Testing including with tools such as xUnit
  • Game engines including Unity and Godot
